verses.23:104: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ

meaning: The root لفح (lfH) primarily describes fire or hot wind (سموم) striking or smiting a face, causing a burning sensation. It can also mean to strike lightly with a sword.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
